evidence.comparison: 4,650 existing canonical/variant/repair SVG original structures; 3,211 existing static SVG original rasters; new full-source family, paint-independent geometry, silhouette and grayscale near-candidates; manually inspected construction contact sheets. evidence.sourceComposition: Three raised brim points wrap around an inset crown with a gold edge and a small crossed-symbol badge.
evidence.semanticReview: Reviewed complete original geometry and rendered construction. Source color, angle, size, expression, component repeats and crop variants are not separate records. Basic-glyph-only overlap and incomplete frame/panel constructions are excluded.
evidence.comparison: 4,650 existing canonical/variant/repair SVG original structures; 3,211 existing static SVG original rasters; new full-source family, paint-independent geometry, silhouette and grayscale near-candidates; manually inspected construction contact sheets. This bounded review does not claim universal uniqueness.

description: Several overlapping rope coils and a trailing loop retain visible winding contours and separate end sections. Original editable SVG illustration; all original geometry, paint and supported filters are retained.
